changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS case_decision_id_idx CASCADE; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS offence_decision_decision_type_idx ON offence_decision (decision_type) WHERE decision_type = 'ADJOURN';
